newsitem.title: UK: UK private client growth funds top in Q1 -study.
newsitem.headline: UK private client growth funds top in Q1 -study.

text.p: Growth funds were the top performers for UK private clients in the first quarter of 1997, performance measurement consultancy WM Company said.

It said its private client indicators, comprising 23 leading private client managers and brokers, showed returns for income funds were 4.3 percent during the quarter, against 3.5 percent for income funds and four percent for balanced funds.

Private client project manager Brian Henderson said growth funds has the highest proportion of their assets invested in Europe, North America and the UK -- some of the top performing markets in the quarter.
Income suffered due to their heavier exposure to fixed interest securities, although the impact of this was limited as they raised their holdings in UK equities to 51 percent from 47.
